title: Cut the Engram full gate's wall time without losing coverage: drop the redundant check, merge the scale phases, fix the slowest materialize and launcher tests, record per-test durations
outcome: Cut the Engram full gate's wall time without losing coverage: drop the redundant check, merge the scale phases, fix the slowest materialize and launcher tests, record per-test durations
acceptance: The full gate keeps every current check and test assertion, with no test skipped or loosened
On the same Windows host, the measured full-gate wall time drops clearly below the 41.6 min baseline of 2026-11-01, with before and after numbers from launcher results
The gate records per-test durations, so the slowest tests are listed without relying on cargo's 60-second warnings
